==Walkthrough==
===Starting the quest===
'''''Bring all items with you. Make the hangover cure now by putting [[chocolate dust]] in a [[bucket of milk]], then add [[snape grass]], being careful not to drink or eat anything.'''''
{{Checklist|*Speak to [[Edmond]]. {{Chat option|1What's happened to her?|1Yes.}}
*Speak to [[Alrena]] inside or near the house.
*Take the [[Picture]] of Elena off the table in the house.
*Speak to Edmond.
*Use 4 [[buckets of water]] on the mud patch behind the house (between the cabbages and potatoes).
*Dig with a [[spade]] on the softened ground.
*Go south to the farthest [[pipe (Plague City)|pipe]].
*Attempt to open the [[grill (Plague City)|grill]].
*Use a [[rope]] on the grill.
*Speak to Edmond.
*Put on the gas mask and climb up the pipe.}}

===Finding Elena===
{{Checklist|*Go east and speak to [[Jethick]]; he will give you a [[Book (Plague City)|book]]. {{Chat option|1Yes, I'll return it for you.}}
*Go north to the house against the wall (next to the [[rotten apple]] spawn).
*Attempt to open the door.
*Speak to [[Martha Rehnison]] or [[Ted Rehnison]] in the house.
*Go upstairs and speak to [[Milli Rehnison]].
*Go south of the town square to the large building along the southern wall with an "X" on the doors and a staircase inside going down. Attempt to open the door. {{Chat option|2I fear not a mere plague.}}}}

===Getting inside===
{{Checklist|*Go to the large main building on the north side of the town square, north of the [[manhole (West Ardougne)|manhole]].
*Talk to the [[Clerk]] in the main room. {{Chat option|1Who is through that door?|3This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!}}
*Speak to [[Bravek]]. {{Chat option|1This is really important though!|3Do you know what's in the cure?}}
*:''He will give you [[a scruffy note]] for a [[hangover cure]].''
*Use the hangover cure on Bravek; he will give you a [[warrant]]. {{Chat option|3They won't listen to me!}}}}

===Finishing up===
{{Checklist|*Return to the [[Mourner]] house, the one with "X" on the doors and the stairwell.
*Search the [[barrel (Plague City)|barrel]] west of the staircase for [[a small key]].
*Go downstairs, enter the cell, and speak to [[Elena]].
*Return to the town square, go down the manhole, through the sewer, climb the [[mud pile (Ardougne Sewers)|mud pile]], and speak to [[Edmond]] at his house.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
